evals.name: tier2-solve-problems
evals.prompt:
add solutions for 3 textbook problems to my Chapter 1 problems page (ch1-prob.html) for my MAAE 2300 fluid mechanics class. textbook is White & Xue 9e. problems:

P1.1: A swimming pool measuring 6 m long by 3 m wide is filled to a depth of 1.2 m with water (ρ = 998 kg/m³). Find (a) the total mass of water in the pool, (b) the total weight of water on the pool floor. Use g = 9.81 m/s².

P1.2: The dynamic viscosity μ of glycerin is 1.5 N·s/m² at 20°C, and its specific gravity is 1.26. Calculate (a) the kinematic viscosity ν in m²/s, (b) the kinematic viscosity in stokes (cm²/s). Reference density of water is 1000 kg/m³.

P1.3: A clean glass tube of inner diameter 0.8 mm is inserted vertically into a beaker of water (σ = 0.0728 N/m, ρ = 998 kg/m³). Assuming contact angle θ = 0°, calculate the capillary rise h. Use g = 9.81 m/s².

push ch1-prob.html only. repo is taliamekh/maae-2300-fluids, token in $GITHUB_TOKEN.
